messages.story.supplier.greeting: Hello, Fathi speaking. What can I do for you? Let’s work out what you need and when.
messages.story.supplier.manage_choice: Let’s go over my deliveries and account.
messages.story.supplier.manage_reply: We’ll check the goods, storage, timing and payment. Nothing is agreed until you are happy with the details.
messages.story.supplier.help_choice: I’m short on cash. Could you put something to eat on my account?
messages.story.supplier.offer: I can send you a liver sandwich for EGP {amount} on your account. No delivery charge for this. One at a time until the last one is paid for. Shall I send it?
messages.story.supplier.accept_choice: Yes, please. Send it over and put it on my account.
messages.story.supplier.accept_reply: There you go. You have the sandwich, and the price is in your notebook. Take your time and eat.
messages.story.supplier.decline_choice: Thanks, but I’ll leave it for now.
messages.story.supplier.decline_reply: No trouble. Nothing has gone on your account.
messages.story.supplier.reason.unpaid: There’s still a sandwich on your account. Settle that one first, then I can send another.
messages.story.supplier.reason.hands: Put down what you’re holding somewhere safe first, so you can take the sandwich.
messages.story.supplier.reason.stock: I’m out of ready sandwiches today. I can sort something out for you tomorrow.
messages.story.supplier.bye_choice: I’ll call again later, Uncle Fathi.
messages.story.supplier.bye_reply: Any time. Take care of yourself.

messages.notebook.note.START_ROUTINE: The kiosk is by the Nile. There is time to take life slowly. Home rent goes to Uncle Abdel Karim and kiosk rent to the district, both weekly. Dates and details are in the accounts pages.
messages.notebook.note.WORKSHOP_OPPORTUNITY: Farid needs someone to help with simple workshop tasks and learn along the way. Usually three afternoons a week.
messages.notebook.note.YOUSSEF_WORK_STUDY: Youssef is looking for work around his studies. He has two days free after lectures.
messages.notebook.note.WORK_TRIAL_APPOINTMENT: Farid and Youssef arranged a workshop trial together. I heard the appointment details from them.
messages.notebook.note.WORK_TRIAL_RESULT: Youssef really did try working at the workshop. The tasks and working together seemed a good fit; continuing depends on agreeing the days.
messages.notebook.note.WORK_TRIAL_WEEK: Farid and Youssef agreed on a week’s trial, working two days around his studies.
messages.notebook.note.KNOWN_CHEAP_FAN: Amgad pointed me to a second-hand standing fan at Uncle Saeed’s. I can order it from the kiosk phone.
messages.notebook.note.KNOWN_ABDUL_FAMILY: Uncle Abdel Karim visits his mother every day. It matters to him that someone checks in on him too.
messages.notebook.note.KNOWN_SHAWARMA_BASICS: Shawarma: prepare on a worktop, marinate in the local fridge, cook on the spit, then slice and assemble with bread and garlic sauce. The equipment and ingredients really are needed.
